name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: Kneeling, roll the wheel forward as far as you can while keeping your back flat, then pull back to the start.

name: Air Bike
description: Push and pull the moving handles while pedalling. Effort scales with how hard you work, which makes it good for short intervals.

name: Assisted Dip
description: Kneel or stand on the assistance pad of a dip machine. The counterweight removes part of your body weight so you can train a full range of motion.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
description: Use an assisted pull-up machine or band to offset part of your body weight while you build toward unassisted reps.

name: Back Extension
description: On a hyperextension bench, hinge at the hips to lower your torso, then raise it until your body forms a straight line. Hug a plate to make it harder.

name: Back Squat
description: With the bar across your upper back, sit down between your heels until your hips are at least level with your knees, then stand back up with your knees tracking over your toes.

name: Band Curl
description: Stand on the middle of a resistance band and curl the ends up toward your shoulders, controlling the band on the way down.

name: Band Face Pull
description: Anchor a band at face height and pull it toward your forehead, spreading your hands apart and squeezing your shoulder blades together.

name: Band Good Morning
description: Stand on a band with the loop around the back of your neck, hinge forward at the hips, and return to standing.

name: Band Pull-Apart
description: Hold a band at shoulder height with straight arms and pull it apart until it touches your chest, then return slowly.

name: Band Pushdown
description: Anchor a band overhead and push it down to your thighs with your elbows fixed at your sides.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar. Lower it with control to the middle of your chest, then press back up to straight arms while keeping your feet planted and shoulder blades pinned together.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Stand with the bar at arm's length and palms facing forward. Curl it toward your shoulders without swinging, then lower it all the way.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: Hold the bar at arm's length and lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears. Pause, then lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

name: Battle Ropes
description: Hold one end of the rope in each hand and make quick alternating waves while staying in a half squat.

name: Bear Crawl
description: On hands and feet with your knees hovering just off the floor, crawl forward by moving opposite hand and foot together.

name: Behind-the-Body Cable Curl
description: Face away from a low pulley and let your arm drift back behind you before curling forward. This trains the biceps in a stretched position.

name: Belt Squat
description: Attach the load to a hip belt and squat with an upright torso. This trains the legs without putting weight on your spine.

name: Bench Dip
description: With your hands on the edge of a bench behind you, lower your hips by bending your elbows to about 90 degrees, then push back up.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
description: Hinge forward to about 45 degrees with a flat back. Pull the bar to your lower ribs while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower it until your arms are straight.

name: Bent-Over Reverse Fly
description: Hinge forward with a flat back and raise the dumbbells out to your sides, leading with your elbows, to work the back of your shoulders.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: Lying on your back, bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg, then switch sides in a pedalling motion.

name: Bird Dog
description: On hands and knees, extend one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your torso, then return and switch.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, sit your hips down and back until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then stand up.

name: Box Jump
description: Swing your arms and jump onto a sturdy box, landing softly with both feet, then step back down.

name: Box Squat
description: Squat back to a box at about knee height, pause briefly while staying tight, then stand up.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: With your rear foot on a bench behind you, lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then drive up through your front foot.

name: Burpee
description: Drop into a push-up position, bring your feet back to your hands, and jump up with your arms overhead.

name: Cable Crossover
description: Stand between two high pulleys with a slight forward lean. Sweep the handles down and together in front of your hips, pause, then let them travel back slowly.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Kneel facing a high pulley with a rope beside your head and curl your torso down, bringing your elbows toward your thighs.

name: Cable Curl
description: Face a low pulley with a straight or EZ handle and curl it up. The cable keeps tension on the muscle through the whole rep.

name: Cable Glute Abduction
description: With an ankle strap on a low pulley, stand side-on and sweep the far leg out to the side, then return slowly.

name: Cable Hammer Curl
description: Attach a rope to a low pulley, hold the ends with palms facing in, and curl them up toward your shoulders.

name: Cable Kickback
description: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and kick your leg straight back, squeezing your glute without arching your back.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: Stand side-on to a low pulley and raise the handle across your body and out to shoulder height. The cable keeps tension on the muscle at the bottom.

name: Cable Pull-Through
description: Face away from a low pulley holding a rope between your legs. Hinge forward, then drive your hips through to stand tall.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
description: Stand between two high pulleys, holding the opposite cables with your arms crossed, and pull them apart and back at shoulder height.

name: Cable Shrug
description: Hold a bar attached to a low pulley and lift your shoulders toward your ears, pausing at the top.

name: Cable Woodchopper
description: Pull the handle diagonally across your body from high to low, rotating through your torso and pivoting on your back foot.

name: Chest Dip
description: On parallel bars, lean your torso forward and lower until your shoulders sit just below your elbows, then press back up.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
description: Lie face down on an incline bench and row both dumbbells up. The bench takes your lower back out of the movement.

name: Chin-Up
description: Hang with your palms facing you about shoulder-width apart, pull your chest toward the bar, and lower with control.

name: Clamshell
description: Lie on your side with knees bent and a band above them. Keep your feet together and lift your top knee, then lower it slowly.

name: Clean and Jerk
description: Clean the bar to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead, splitting your feet to catch it at arm's length.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Grip the bar about shoulder-width apart. Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides as you lower the bar to your lower chest and press back up, letting the triceps do most of the work.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
description: Use a narrow neutral-grip handle and pull it to your chest, keeping your elbows tight to your sides.

name: Concentration Curl
description: Sit with your elbow braced against your inner thigh and curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.

name: Cossack Squat
description: From a wide stance, shift your weight onto one leg and squat deep on that side while the other leg stays straight, then switch.

name: Crunch
description: Lying on your back with knees bent, curl your shoulders off the floor toward your hips, then lower slowly.

name: Cycling
description: Log outdoor rides by distance and time.

name: Dead Bug
description: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent over your hips. Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping your lower back pressed to the floor.

name: Dead Hang
description: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms for time, letting your shoulders relax while keeping a firm grip.

name: Deadlift
description: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet, hinge down to grip it just outside your legs, brace hard, and stand up by pushing the floor away. Keep the bar close to your legs the entire way.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
description: Hook your legs under the pads of a decline bench, lower the bar to your lower chest, and press it back up in a slight arc toward your face.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
description: Secure your legs on a decline bench, lower the dumbbells to the sides of your lower chest, and press until your arms are straight.

name: Decline Push-Up
description: Rest your feet on a raised surface and perform push-ups. The higher your feet, the more your upper chest and shoulders work.

name: Decline Sit-Up
description: Hook your feet on a decline bench and sit up until your chest approaches your knees, then lower slowly. Hold a plate to add load.

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Make a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers beneath your chest and lower yourself, keeping your elbows close to your body.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest. Lower them out to the sides until you feel a stretch across the chest, then press up and slightly inward.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: Holding dumbbells at your sides, rise up onto your toes and lower slowly back down.

name: Dumbbell Curl
description: Curl the dumbbells up while turning your palms to face the ceiling, keeping your elbows by your sides.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: With a soft, fixed bend in your elbows, open your arms in a wide hugging arc until your chest stretches, then squeeze the dumbbells back together above you.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description: Lift the dumbbells straight in front of you to eye level with nearly straight arms, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: With a slight bend in your elbows, raise the dumbbells out to your sides until your arms are level with your shoulders, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension
description: Lying on a bench with dumbbells above you, bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head, then straighten your arms.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: Lying on a bench, hold one dumbbell above your chest with both hands. Lower it behind your head in a smooth arc, then pull it back over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs and hinge at the hips, lowering them along your legs until your hamstrings stretch, then stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: With a dumbbell at each side, raise your shoulders as high as you can and hold briefly at the top before lowering.

name: Dumbbell Snatch
description: From a hinge with one dumbbell between your feet, explode up and punch the dumbbell overhead in a single motion.

name: Dumbbell Step-Over
description: Step up onto a box and straight down the other side, alternating your lead leg each rep.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
description: Raise the dumbbells along the front of your body to lower-chest height, leading with your elbows.

name: Elliptical
description: Stride on the elliptical at a steady pace, pushing and pulling the handles to involve your upper body.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
description: Use the angled grips of an EZ bar, which put your wrists in a more comfortable position, and curl as you would with a straight bar.

name: Face Pull
description: With a rope on a high pulley, pull toward your face while spreading the rope apart, finishing with your hands beside your ears.

name: Farmer's Carry
description: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and walk with short, steady steps, standing tall with your shoulders level.

name: Front Squat
description: Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with your elbows high, squat down with an upright torso, and drive back up.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on your back with your knees bent and push through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a line from shoulders to knees.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest and squat down between your knees, keeping your chest up.

name: Good Morning
description: With the bar on your upper back and knees softly bent, push your hips back and lower your chest until your hamstrings stretch, then stand back up.

name: Hack Squat
description: With your back against the sled pad, lower until your thighs are around parallel and push through your whole foot to return.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other and curl them up, keeping that neutral grip the whole time.

name: Handstand Push-Up
description: Kick up into a handstand against a wall, lower your head toward the floor, and press back to straight arms.

name: Hang Clean
description: Start with the bar at mid-thigh, jump it up with your hips, and pull yourself under to catch it on your shoulders.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: Hang from a bar and draw your knees up toward your chest, curling your hips slightly at the top.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from a bar and raise your straight legs to hip height or higher without swinging.

name: Hiking
description: Log hikes by distance and time. Carrying a loaded pack makes it harder.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
description: Sit with the pads on the outside of your knees, push your legs apart, then let them return slowly.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
description: Sit with the pads on the inside of your knees and squeeze your legs together, then let them open slowly.

name: Hip Thrust
description: With your upper back on a bench and the bar across your hips, drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level, squeezing your glutes at the top.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: Lie on your back, press your lower back into the floor, and lift your arms, shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground. Hold.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
description: Set the bench to roughly 30 degrees. Lower the bar to your upper chest just below the collarbones and press it back up over your shoulders.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Sit back on a bench set to 45–60 degrees with your arms hanging behind your body and curl. This stretches the biceps at the bottom of each rep.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
description: Perform a fly on a bench set to about 30 degrees, keeping the elbow angle locked so the motion comes from the shoulders rather than the arms.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: On a bench set to 30–45 degrees, lower the dumbbells beside your upper chest and press them back up over your shoulders.

name: Incline Push-Up
description: Place your hands on a bench or box to make the push-up easier, keeping your hips level with your shoulders throughout.

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
description: Walk on a steep treadmill incline at a steady pace without holding on to the rails.

name: Incline Y-Raise
description: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and raise light dumbbells overhead in a Y shape with your thumbs pointing up.

name: Inverted Row
description: Lie under a bar set around hip height, hold it with straight arms, and pull your chest to the bar while keeping your body rigid.

name: Jump Rope
description: Skip a rope with small, quick hops on the balls of your feet, turning the rope with your wrists.

name: Jump Squat
description: Squat down, then jump as high as you can. Land softly and flow straight into the next rep.

name: Jumping Jack
description: Jump your feet out wide while raising your arms overhead, then jump back to the start, keeping a steady rhythm.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
description: With a kettlebell between your feet, hinge down to grab the handle and stand up by driving your hips forward.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
description: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest and squat down between your knees, keeping your chest up and elbows inside your knees.

name: Kettlebell Halo
description: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle and circle it slowly around your head, keeping it close and your core braced.

name: Kettlebell Press
description: Hold the kettlebell in the rack position against your forearm and press it overhead, turning your palm forward as it rises.

name: Kettlebell Row
description: Brace one hand on a bench and row the kettlebell toward your hip, keeping your back flat.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Hinge to hike the kettlebell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward so it floats to chest height. Let it fall back and repeat.

name: Landmine One-Arm Row
description: Stand side-on to a landmine, hinge forward, and row the end of the bar toward your hip with one hand.

name: Landmine Press
description: Hold the end of a landmine bar at shoulder height and press it up and forward at an angle, with one arm or both.

name: Landmine Rotation
description: Hold the end of a landmine bar overhead with both hands and swing it in an arc from one hip to the other, turning through your torso.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Grip the bar a little wider than your shoulders, lean back slightly, and pull it to your upper chest by driving your elbows down toward your ribs.

name: Lateral Band Walk
description: With a band around your knees or ankles, sit into a half squat and step sideways while keeping tension on the band.

name: Leg Extension
description: Sit with the pad on your lower shins and straighten your knees fully, pausing at the top before lowering.

name: Leg Press
description: Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees, then press back without slamming your knees straight.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
description: On the leg press, place only the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform and push through your toes.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
description: With the pulleys set low, bring the handles up and inward so they meet at chest height. This angle emphasises the upper part of the chest.

name: Lying Leg Curl
description: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels and curl your heels toward your glutes, keeping your hips on the bench.

name: Lying Leg Raise
description: Lying on your back, keep your legs straight and lift them to vertical, then lower without letting your lower back arch.

name: Lying Triceps Extension
description: Lying on a bench, lower an EZ bar toward your forehead by bending only at the elbows, then extend back up.

name: Machine Chest Press
description: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest. Push them forward until your arms are nearly straight, then return under control.

name: Machine Crunch
description: Sit with the pads against your chest or hands on the handles and curl your torso forward against the resistance.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
description: Set the pad across your hips, drive up until your hips are fully extended, and pause before lowering.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
description: Sit with the pads against the outside of your upper arms and raise them out to shoulder height, pausing briefly at the top.

name: Machine Preacher Curl
description: Set the seat so your armpits sit at the top of the pad and curl the handles toward your shoulders, lowering slowly.

name: Machine Row
description: With your chest against the pad, pull the handles back until your elbows pass your torso, then return slowly.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
description: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height and press them overhead, lowering slowly between reps.

name: Machine Triceps Extension
description: Sit with your upper arms on the pad and push the handles down and out until your elbows are straight.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
description: Lift the ball overhead, then slam it into the floor as hard as you can and pick it up for the next rep.

name: Mountain Climber
description: From a high plank, drive your knees toward your chest one at a time at a quick, steady pace.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
description: Using parallel handles, pull yourself up until your chin passes the handles. Many people find this grip easier on the shoulders.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
description: Kneel with your ankles anchored and lower your torso toward the floor as slowly as you can, catching yourself with your hands.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Support one hand and knee on a bench. Pull the dumbbell toward your hip with your elbow close to your side, then lower until your arm is long.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
description: Face away from the pulley with a rope held behind your head and extend your arms forward and up until they are straight.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
description: Hold one dumbbell with both hands behind your head and straighten your arms overhead, keeping your elbows pointing up.

name: Overhead Press
description: Standing with the bar on your front shoulders, brace your core and press it straight overhead. Move your head back slightly to clear the bar, then push through to lockout.

name: Pallof Press
description: Stand side-on to a cable set at chest height, hold the handle at your chest, and press it straight out while resisting the pull to rotate.

name: Pec Deck
description: Sit tall with your forearms or hands on the pads. Bring the pads together in front of you, hold the squeeze for a moment, and open back up slowly.

name: Pendlay Row
description: Start every rep with the bar resting on the floor and your torso close to parallel with it. Row explosively to your upper stomach and set the bar back down.

name: Pike Push-Up
description: Start in an inverted V with your hips high and lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands, then press back up.

name: Pistol Squat
description: Balance on one leg with the other held out in front, squat down as low as you can, and stand back up.

name: Plank
description: Rest on your forearms and toes with your body in a straight line from head to heels. Squeeze your glutes and hold.

name: Plate Front Raise
description: Hold a weight plate by its sides and raise it in front of you to eye level, then lower it slowly.

name: Plate Pinch
description: Pinch two smooth plates together between your fingers and thumb and hold them at your side for time.

name: Plate Squeeze Press
description: Press two plates together between your palms at chest height and push them straight out in front of you, keeping the squeeze the whole time.

name: Power Clean
description: Pull the bar from the floor with a powerful hip extension, then drop under it to catch it on the front of your shoulders in a quarter squat.

name: Preacher Curl
description: Rest the backs of your upper arms on a preacher pad and curl the bar up, lowering until your arms are almost straight.

name: Pull-Up
description: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, pull until your chin clears the bar, and lower all the way back to a dead hang.

name: Push Press
description: Dip slightly at the knees, then drive up hard with your legs and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.

name: Push-Up
description: From a straight-arm plank with your hands a little wider than your shoulders, lower your chest until it nearly touches the floor and push back up, keeping your body in one straight line.

name: Rack Pull
description: Set the bar on safety pins around knee height and pull it to lockout, training the top half of the deadlift with heavier loads.

name: Renegade Row
description: From a push-up position on two dumbbells, row one weight to your hip while keeping your hips square to the floor, then switch sides.

name: Reverse Curl
description: Hold the bar with your palms facing down and curl it up. This shifts more of the work onto your forearms.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: Lie face down on the machine with your legs hanging off the end and raise them until they are level with your torso.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: Step backward into a lunge until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees, then push through your front heel to return.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
description: Face the pec deck, grip the handles at shoulder height, and sweep your arms back until they line up with your body.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Rest your forearms on a bench with palms down and lift the back of your hands toward the ceiling.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Holding the bar at hip height, push your hips back with soft knees and slide the bar down your thighs until your hamstrings stretch strongly, then return to standing.

name: Rope Pushdown
description: Push the rope down and spread the ends apart at the bottom so your elbows straighten fully.

name: Rotating Dumbbell Press
description: Start with the dumbbells in front of your face, palms toward you. Turn your palms outward as you press up, and reverse the rotation on the way down.

name: Rowing Machine
description: Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower ribs. Reverse that order on the way back.

name: Running
description: Log outdoor or track runs by distance and time.

name: Russian Twist
description: Sit with your torso leaned back and feet off the floor, then rotate side to side, touching the floor beside each hip. Hold a weight to make it harder.

name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
description: Sit on an upright bench and press the bar from the top of your chest to overhead, keeping your back against the pad.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Sit with your knees slightly bent and pull the handle to your stomach, chest tall and shoulders back. Let your arms reach forward fully on the return.

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: Sit with the pad on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform, then raise and lower your heels through a full range.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
description: Sit on an upright bench to stop yourself swinging and curl the dumbbells up together or one at a time.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Sit upright with dumbbells at shoulder height and palms facing forward, then press them overhead until your arms are straight.

name: Seated Leg Curl
description: Sit with the pad behind your lower calves and the thigh pad locked down, then pull your heels under the seat.

name: Side Plank
description: Support yourself on one forearm with your feet stacked and lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
description: Push a single handle down with one arm, keeping your elbow fixed at your side, then let it rise slowly.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
description: Pull a single handle down beside your body, driving your elbow toward your hip, then let it rise until your arm is fully extended.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
description: Stand on one foot on a step, lower your heel below the edge, then push up onto your toes. Hold something for balance.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
description: Perform a glute bridge with one foot on the floor and the other leg lifted, keeping your hips level.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: Balancing on one leg, hinge forward while the other leg extends behind you, lowering the weight until your torso is nearly level with the floor.

name: Sissy Squat
description: Holding a support, lean back and bend your knees forward while rising onto your toes, lowering until you feel a deep stretch in your quads.

name: Sit-Up
description: Lying on your back with knees bent and feet anchored, roll your torso all the way up until you are sitting, then lower back down with control.

name: Ski Machine
description: Pull the two handles down from overhead in a fast, hinging motion, then let them rise as you stand back up.

name: Sled Push
description: Lean into the sled handles with your arms extended and drive it forward with short, powerful steps.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
description: Place a flat bench under the Smith bar. Unrack it, lower to mid-chest along the fixed path, and press back to lockout.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
description: Stand on a block under the Smith bar and rise onto your toes, pausing at the top and stretching at the bottom.

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
description: Position an incline bench so the bar meets your upper chest at the bottom of the rep, then press up and lower with control.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
description: Sit on an upright bench under the Smith bar and press it from chin height to overhead along the fixed track.

name: Smith Machine Squat
description: Set the Smith bar on your upper back with your feet slightly forward and squat down along the fixed path, then stand up.

name: Snatch
description: With a wide grip, pull the bar from the floor and drop under it to catch it overhead in one continuous movement.

name: Spider Curl
description: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight down and curl the weights up, squeezing hard at the top.

name: Split Squat
description: Stand in a long staggered stance and lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright, then rise back up.

name: Stair Climber
description: Climb the moving steps at a steady pace, standing tall and holding the rails only lightly for balance.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, lower your heels for a full stretch, then rise as high as you can.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Press dumbbells overhead while standing, keeping your ribs down and glutes tight so your lower back doesn't arch.

name: Stationary Bike
description: Pedal at a steady or interval pace on an indoor bike, recording distance and time.

name: Step-Up
description: Place one foot on a box or bench and stand up onto it, then lower the trailing leg slowly back to the floor.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description: With your knees only slightly bent, hinge forward to lower the bar toward the floor, then return to standing using your hamstrings.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
description: Facing a high pulley with nearly straight arms, sweep the bar down to your thighs using your lats, then let it rise back to eye level.

name: Suitcase Carry
description: Carry a single heavy weight in one hand and walk without leaning toward it.

name: Sumo Deadlift
description: Take a wide stance with your toes turned out and grip the bar inside your knees. Push your knees outward and drive through the floor until you are standing tall.

name: Superman Hold
description: Lie face down and lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time. Hold the position while breathing steadily.

name: Swimming
description: Log swims by distance and time.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Straddle a landmine or T-bar handle, hinge forward, and pull the weight toward your chest with a neutral grip.

name: Thruster
description: Front squat, then use the drive out of the bottom to press the bar overhead in one smooth movement.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
description: Stand inside the hex-shaped bar, grip the side handles, and stand up with a more upright torso than a standard deadlift.

name: Treadmill Run
description: Run on a treadmill and record distance and time. A 1% incline roughly matches the effort of running outdoors.

name: Triceps Dip
description: Stay upright on parallel bars and lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees, then press back to straight arms.

name: Triceps Kickback
description: Hinge forward with your upper arm parallel to the floor and extend the dumbbell back until your arm is straight.

name: Triceps Pushdown
description: With a bar on a high pulley, keep your elbows pinned to your sides and push down until your arms are straight.

name: Turkish Get-Up
description: Lying down with a kettlebell held straight above you, stand up in a series of controlled steps while keeping the weight overhead, then reverse back down.

name: Upright Row
description: Hold the bar with your hands a little wider than shoulder-width and pull it up along your body to lower-chest height, elbows leading.

name: V-Up
description: Lie flat, then lift your legs and torso at the same time so your hands reach toward your feet at the top.

name: Walking
description: Log walks by distance and time. A brisk pace counts as easy cardio.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Step forward into a lunge, lower your back knee toward the floor, then push off and bring your back leg through into the next step.

name: Wall Ball
description: Squat holding a medicine ball at your chest, then stand and throw it to a target high on the wall, catching it as you drop into the next squat.

name: Wall Sit
description: Slide down a wall until your thighs are parallel to the floor and hold the position.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
description: Add load with a dip belt or weighted vest and perform strict pull-ups. Log the added weight, not your body weight.

name: Wrist Curl
description: Rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench with palms up and curl the weight using only your wrists.
